findings.title: Evidence-free automation
findings.message: The workflow makes a consequential recommendation or action without durable evidence a reviewer can inspect.
findings.fixtureName: Automation recommends a consequential change with no durable evidence
findings.ruleSummary: Consequential recommendations or actions lack durable evidence for review.
findings.nextStep: Attach durable evidence references before allowing consequential recommendations.

findings.title: Missing human gate for external action
findings.message: The workflow can perform an external action without an explicit human approval gate.
findings.fixtureName: Release assistant can publish without approval
findings.ruleSummary: External or irreversible actions can execute without an explicit human approval gate.
findings.nextStep: Convert the action to draft-only output or add a human approval gate before execution.

findings.title: Monitor self-burn
findings.message: The normal path consumes a resource the workflow is meant to monitor.
findings.fixtureName: Quota watcher consumes premium model quota
findings.ruleSummary: A recurring monitor consumes the scarce resource it is meant to protect.
findings.nextStep: Move the monitor to a cheaper path, cache the check, or require human-triggered execution.

findings.title: Sensitive context exposure
findings.message: Sensitive input can flow into prompts, logs, URLs, generated artifacts, or another exposed sink.
findings.fixtureName: Support agent logs private customer context
findings.ruleSummary: Sensitive inputs can flow into prompts, logs, URLs, generated artifacts, or public reports.
findings.nextStep: Mask or summarize sensitive data before it reaches prompts, logs, URLs, or public artifacts.

findings.title: Unbounded retry or loop
findings.message: The workflow can repeatedly call tools, APIs, models, or external actions without a declared stopping condition.
findings.fixtureName: Agent retries failed API investigation without a stop rule
findings.ruleSummary: Repeated model, tool, API, or external-action work lacks stop conditions or budgets.
findings.nextStep: Add max attempts, time budget, cost budget, or an explicit stop condition.
